Department for General Assembly and Conference Management, Protocol and Liaison Service -- Protocol Announcement – Open HouseAn “Open House – Q&A session” on the upcoming general debate and high-level meetings of the eighty-first session of the General Assembly will be held on Wednesday, 19 August 2026, from 14:00 to 18:00 in Conference Room F. Jointly hosted by the Department for General Assembly and Conference Management, the Department of Safety and Security, the Department of Global Communications, and the Executive Office of the Secretary-General, the Open House will provide information on key operational and logistical aspects of the general debate and high-level week, including registration procedures, access passes, speakers’ lists, interpretation services and bilateral booths, as well as other logistical arrangements related to the general debate and high-level meetings.Attendees will also have the opportunity to engage with UN focal points in one-on-one consultations to address any outstanding questions. No appointment is required. Representatives of Permanent Missions and Observer Offices, as well as offices of specialized agencies and related organizations, are invited to attend.
